aliases: CyrusOne Thad Hill data center phase 2
status_detail: Texas Comptroller qualifying large data center registration effective 2026-04-13 lists C1 Bosque II LLC with occupant Amazon Data Services, Inc. notes: SEC filing reports 400 MW total under CyrusOne contract across the first 190 MW and second 210 MW facilities.

aliases: Bulldog Power / Old Ocean data center and power plant
status_detail: Brazoria County Legistar file 18086 set a hearing for Old Ocean Datacenter LLC tax abatement/reinvestment zone and states the applicant would construct a 310 MW hyperscale data center with at least $1.5B expenditure on about 159 acres. notes: Capacity shown as 620 MW from local reporting on two 310 MW data centers; official county item directly confirms one 310 MW Old Ocean Datacenter LLC component.
